question: Rajasthan ka rajya nritya kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Ghoomar Rajasthan ka rajya nritya hai; Marwar ki Rajput mahilayein ghaghra ghumate hue nachti hain. | Galat kyun: Kalbeliya Sapera samuday ka nritya hai (UNESCO 2010); Kacchi Ghodi Shekhawati ka nakli-ghode wala nritya hai; Terah Taali Kamad samuday ka hai. | Concept: Rajya nritya = rajya ki pehchan wala lok nritya. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Ghoomar = ghaghra ghumna (Marwar). | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Kalbeliya nritya ko UNESCO ne kab Intangible Heritage ghoshit kiya?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Kalbeliya ko UNESCO ne 2010 me Intangible Cultural Heritage ghoshit kiya; Gulabo Sapera ne ise duniya bhar me prasiddh kiya. | Galat kyun: 2013 Hill Forts ka varsh hai; 2008 aur 2016 me Kalbeliya ko koi UNESCO ghoshna nahi mili. | Concept: UNESCO Intangible Heritage = jeevant sanskritik parampara ki manyata. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kalbeliya = Sapera samuday, UNESCO 2010. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md; UNESCO ICH list.

question: Bani Thani kis chitrakala shaili se sambandhit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Bani Thani Kishangarh shaili ki prasiddh kriti hai; Nihal Chand ne banayi; ise 'Bharat ki Mona Lisa' kaha jata hai. | Galat kyun: Mewar, Bundi aur Kota ki apni shailiyan hain, lekin Bani Thani unse nahi judi. | Concept: Chitrakala shaili ↔ uski prasiddh kriti aur chitrakar. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Bani Thani = Kishangarh = Nihal Chand. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Phad painting kis katha par aadharit hai aur kahan ki hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Phad painting Shahpura (Bhilwara) ki hai; isme Pabuji aur Devnarayan ki lok kathayein lambi scroll par chitrit hoti hain. | Galat kyun: Krishna/Nathdwara Pichwai se juda hai; shikar Kota shaili ki pehchan hai; Ramayana Mewar shaili me milta hai. | Concept: Phad = katha wali scroll painting. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Phad = Shahpura = Pabuji ki lambi katha. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Pichwai chitrakala kahan ki hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Pichwai Nathdwara ki chitrakala hai, Shrinathji (Krishna) par aadharit. | Galat kyun: Shahpura Phad se, Kishangarh Bani Thani se, Bundi prakriti-chitran se juda hai. | Concept: Dharmik chitrakala ↔ sthan aur devta. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pichwai = Nathdwara = Shrinathji. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Blue Pottery kahan ki prasiddh kala hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Blue Pottery Jaipur ki prasiddh kala hai; iska firozi (neela) rang iski pehchan hai aur ise GI Tag mila hai. | Galat kyun: Jodhpur Bandhej aur Mojari se, Bikaner unta-kala se, Udaipur Pichwai/Mewar shaili se juda hai. | Concept: Hastshilp ↔ sthan ↔ GI Tag. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Blue Pottery = Jaipur ka neela rang. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Kota Doria kis cheez ke liye prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Kota Doria Kota ki halki, bareek bunai wali saree hai; ise GI Tag mila hai. | Galat kyun: Blue Pottery Jaipur ki hai; Marble Makrana ka hai; Kathputli Nagaur/Marwar ki hai. | Concept: Hastshilp ↔ sthan aur uski visheshta. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kota Doria = Kota ki halki saree. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Thewa kala kahan ki hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Thewa kala Pratapgarh ki hai; isme kaanch par sone ki bareek kala ki jati hai. | Galat kyun: Jaipur Blue Pottery aur block print se, Jodhpur Bandhej se, Nagaur Kathputli se juda hai. | Concept: Hastshilp ↔ sthan aur takneek. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Thewa = Pratapgarh = kaanch par sona. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Pushkar Mela kab manaya jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Pushkar Mela Kartik Purnima par manaya jata hai; unta mela aur Brahma mandir prasiddh hain. | Galat kyun: Magh Purnima par Baneshwar Mela lagta hai; Shravan me Teej aur Chaitra me Gangaur manaye jate hain. | Concept: Mela ↔ tithi aur sthan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pushkar = Kartik Purnima = unta mela. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Baneshwar Mela kis samuday ka hai aur kahan lagta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Baneshwar Mela Dungarpur me Magh Purnima par Bhil samuday ka mela hai. | Galat kyun: Gujjar Karauli me Kaila Devi se, Jain Mount Abu se, Rajput Jaipur se jude hain — Baneshwar se nahi. | Concept: Mela ↔ samuday ↔ sthan ↔ tithi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Baneshwar = Bhil + Dungarpur + Magh Purnima. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Terah Taali nritya kis samuday se juda hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Terah Taali Kamad samuday (Pali) ka nritya hai; kalakar shareer par 13 manjire bandhkar nachta hai. | Galat kyun: Bhil Baneshwar se, Kalbeliya Sapera samuday se, Manganiyar Marwar ke gayak samuday se jude hain. | Concept: Nritya ↔ samuday ↔ kshetra. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Terah Taali = 13 manjire = Kamad (Pali). | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Hill Forts of Rajasthan ko UNESCO World Heritage kab ghoshit kiya gaya?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Hill Forts of Rajasthan (6 kile: Chittorgarh, Kumbhalgarh, Ranthambore, Gagron, Amber, Jaisalmer) 2013 me UNESCO World Heritage bane. | Galat kyun: 1982 Keoladeo ka, 2010 Jantar Mantar ka varsh hai; 2016 me koi Rajasthan UNESCO ghoshna nahi hui. | Concept: UNESCO World Heritage ↔ varsh ↔ sthal. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 6 kile = 2013 (Chittor, Kumbhalgarh, Ranthambore, Gagron, Amber, Jaisalmer). | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md; UNESCO WHC list.

question: Jantar Mantar, Jaipur ko UNESCO World Heritage kab ghoshit kiya gaya?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Jantar Mantar, Jaipur 2010 me UNESCO World Heritage bana; ise Sawai Jai Singh II ne banwaya tha. | Galat kyun: 2013 Hill Forts ka, 1982 Keoladeo ka varsh hai; 2008 me Jantar Mantar ko UNESCO manyata nahi mili. | Concept: UNESCO sthal ↔ varsh ↔ nirmata. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jantar Mantar = Jai Singh II = 2010. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md; UNESCO WHC list.

question: Sabse bada kila (Bharat) kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Chittorgarh Bharat ka sabse bada kila mana jata hai; isme Vijay Stambh aur Kirti Stambh hain. | Galat kyun: Amer, Mehrangarh aur Kumbhalgarh bade kile hain, lekin kshetrafal me Chittorgarh se chhote hain. | Concept: Kila ↔ uski visheshta (sabse bada). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Chittorgarh = sabse bada kila + Vijay Stambh. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Kumbhalgarh kile ki deewar kis liye prasiddh hai?
option_b: Duniya ki dusri sabse lambi deewar
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Kumbhalgarh kile ki deewar Great Wall of China ke baad duniya ki dusri sabse lambi deewar mani jati hai. | Galat kyun: Yeh sabse purani ya sabse unchi deewar nahi hai, aur yah pani me bana kila nahi hai. | Concept: Kila ↔ uski visheshta (deewar ki lambai). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kumbhalgarh ki deewar = China ki deewar ke baad dusri. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Jaisalmer kila kis naam se jana jata hai aur kyun?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Jaisalmer kila 'Sonar Kila' hai kyunki yah peeli balua patthar (yellow sandstone) se bana hai; yah jeevant kila (living fort) bhi hai. | Galat kyun: Taragarh pahadi kila hai (Ajmer/Bundi); Junagarh Bikaner ka hai; Lohagarh Bharatpur ka mitti ka kila hai. | Concept: Kila ↔ upnaam ↔ karan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sonar Kila = peela patthar = Jaisalmer. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Gagron kila kis prakar ka durg hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Gagron (Jhalawar) jal-durg hai kyunki yah pani se ghira hai; yah UNESCO Hill Forts me shamil hai. | Galat kyun: Giri-durg pahadi par, sthal-durg maidan me, van-durg jungle me banta hai — Gagron inme se koi nahi. | Concept: Durg ke prakar = uski sthiti (pahad/maidan/van/pani). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Gagron = jal se ghira = Jal-durg. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Gangaur tyohar kis devi-devta se juda hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Gangaur Chaitra me Shiv-Parvati ke liye manaya jata hai (Jaipur/Udaipur me prasiddh). | Galat kyun: Krishna-Radha Holi/Janmashtami se, Vishnu-Lakshmi Diwali se, Ram-Sita Dussehra/Diwali se jude hain. | Concept: Tyohar ↔ devi-devta ↔ samay. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Gangaur = Chaitra = Shiv-Parvati. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Manganiyar aur Langa kis kshetra ke prasiddh lok gayak hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Manganiyar aur Langa Marwar (Barmer-Jaisalmer) ke prasiddh lok gayak samuday hain. | Galat kyun: Mewar Udaipur kshetra hai, Shekhawati Kacchi Ghodi/Chang se, Hadoti Kota-Bundi se juda hai. | Concept: Lok gayak samuday ↔ kshetra. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Manganiyar-Langa = Marwar ke registan ke gayak. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.

question: Makrana marble kis liye prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Makrana (Nagaur) ka marble Taj Mahal me prayog hua; ise GI Tag mila hai. | Galat kyun: Kota Doria saree hai, Thewa kaanch par sone ki kala hai, Blue Pottery Jaipur ki hai — marble se sambandh nahi. | Concept: Khanij/shilp ↔ uska prasiddh prayog. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Makrana marble = Taj Mahal. | Source: notes/02_art_culture_rajasthan.md.
